cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check iptables for any blocks
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("iptables -L INPUT -n --line-numbers 2>&1 | head -20")
print("IPT:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check what's listening on all interfaces
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep LISTEN")
print("Listen:", stdout.read().decode()[:800])
client.close()
EOF
